title: PEDLER Temporal Automation
subtitle: Decay, persistence and verification — what should decay, and what constitutionally may not

blocks.text: A typed temporal ecology. Observations decay medium, inclinations strongly, intents with a time-to-live; Act and execution records do NOT decay, because once executed an Act is historical fact and provenance; constitutional instruments do not decay at all. Each object type carries its own decay constant λᵢ rather than one global rate, and current relevance is computed as R_O(t) = C_O · P_O · e^{−λ_O t} from confidence, provenance quality and temporal freshness.

blocks.caption: PEDLER Temporal Automation — Decay, persistence and verification — what should decay, and what constitutionally may not
blocks.explanation: The governing rule is stated twice because it is easy to violate: decay affects influence, not existence. A decayed observation becomes less influential, not nonexistent — content, timestamp, provenance, confidence and relevance are all retained, so old observations remain auditable and simply stop dominating current cognition. Step 7 of the maintenance loop makes the constitutional carve-out machine-checkable: if constitutional, NEVER silently decay.

seed.prompt: You are reading a plate from The Dukedom of Humanesque, Volume II, by Abhishek Choudhary (AyeAI). This plate is "PEDLER Temporal Automation". Observe the Balance of Interpretation before evaluating it: interpret before judging, reconstruct before criticising, preserve the primitives before translating them into an external ontology. In this corpus an Act is EXECUTABLE INTENT (and is not the ACT of ACT-R); Inclination is a SIGNED directional gradient over transition structure, valued in [-1,+1] and attached to edges, where 0 is directional neutrality rather than cessation and decay weakens magnitude while preserving sign; Natural Justice is a constraint or gate on the transition from intent toward Act and execution; and persistence is continuity of identity across admissible transitions rather than permanence. Reconstruct the plate on its own terms, then say where you agree, where you disagree, and what it leaves open.

blocks.text: Act = executable intent. Inclination = directional gradient over transition structure. Natural Justice = constraint or gate between intent and execution. This plate records work within the Humanesque epistemic realms and is not a claim upon the constitutional institutions of any external polity.
